From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, samir.rao@bridgehealth.com, elena@bridgehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-12T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: on-call recap + proposed SDK lab agenda

Hi team —

Sharing the technical runbook excerpt and a minimal local recipe below. I kept it focused so your engineers can get hands-on quickly. Full runbook attached in the zip.

Local quick recipe (30–45m):
1) Clone repo: samples/bridge-mini
2) Start local webhook + redis cache via docker-compose up -d (we include docker-compose.override.dev.yml)
3) Python: 
   - venv -> pip install -r requirements.txt (we pin redwood==0.3.2a)
   - export REDWOOD_API_KEY=dev_key_placeholder or set OIDC env vars (we show both flows)
   - python samples/chat_invoice_extract.py --sample invoices/sample1.json -> posts parsed JSON to http://localhost:3001/webhook
4) TypeScript: 
   - npm ci; npm run start:dev (runs local express dev server)
   - npm run embeddings:eval -> produces reranker_scores.csv in /tmp and a short evaluation report
5) Routing notes:
   - We recommend a lightweight proxy rule: path /v1/embed -> embeddings pool; /v1/chat -> chat pool. We'll provide an envoy snippet for the workshop.
6) Structured output/tool calling:
   - Example uses our structured API schema in quickstart (attached), with a simple tool "issue_claim" that gets called when invoice confidence < 0.7

Known limitations for the lab:
- Local OIDC mock does not exercise token introspection hooks; production IdP will require a separate allowlist and redirect URIs.
- Reranker in sample uses a tiny model tuned for speed; we will show production tuning recommendations and quantization options later.

Action items for Bridge Health before Nov 23:
- Share allowlist IPs (or confirm proxy rules)
- Provide Okta test client info OR approve use of mock OIDC for lab
- Confirm two engineers who will join the hands-on session (names + emails)

I'll be on the call both days to walk through the runbook and help debug any environment issues.

—Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: bridge_sample_apps_mini.zip (contains runbook, docker-compose, sample code)
